Folder structure

data-quality-service/
├── config/rules.yml
├── data/input.csv
├── dbt_project.yml
├── models/
│   ├── staging/
│   └── quality/
├── macros/tests/
├── scripts/
│   ├── load_csv.py
│   └── build_report.py
├── reports/index.html
└── quality.duckdb

Scoring method

Each rule score is 1 − failed / evaluated. Dimension scores are weighted by evaluated values. The overall score uses configurable dimension weights.

overall = Σ(dimension_score × weight)

default weights:
  completeness: 0.40
  accuracy:     0.35
  validity:     0.25

Execution

python scripts/load_csv.py data/input.csv
dbt build --profiles-dir .
python scripts/build_report.py

# generated outputs
reports/index.html
reports/failures.csv
artifacts/run_results.json
